# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 9 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Eve's Second Penance

---

**9:1** Michael said to Adam: 'Go and call Eve.' Adam went and found Eve standing in the water of the river Tigris.

**9:2** Adam took Eve by the hand and led her out of the water, and told her all that Michael had said.

**9:3** Eve wept and said: 'Woe to me, for I have not persevered in my penance as you have in yours. But perhaps the Lord will pardon me because of your penance.'

**9:4** Adam said to Eve: 'Do not weep. God is merciful and will have compassion on us.'

---
